question:
In the figure given below the square represents switches, the triangle represents tube lights and the circle represents bulbs. The number in each area represents the number of items in that area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98868d132fd4df881621780aac66fc11dc610613c1db540123c8501048fc54a7.png] 

Which of the following statement is NOT correct?

I. Number of switches which are tube lights are 5.

II. Total number of bulb are 19 .
solution:
**Given: **In the figure given below the square represents switches, the triangle represents tube lights and the circle represents bulbs. The number in each area represents the number of items in that area.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f27679f64b0a03df689aac91b7efd63d9086b231c6c172f68569ba70f028097f.png] 

I. Number of switches which are tube lights are 5. - True

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adc090b3222aec43c8dbd86c85047cc9ef49e6a87e041f51d535bcf463acecb5.png] II. Total number of bulb are 19 - False

Number of bulb 8 + 4 + 3 + 2 = 17

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/439cd8cec168ac01eab2e32d377cdee99f34d45755eaa301109bd512090e9421.png] 

Thus, 'Only II' is not correct.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
